# Vendored motion libraries

These files are checked in so the site has no runtime CDN dependency and no build step.
Do not edit the minified files. Update the versions here and in `/README.md` when upgrading.

| File | Package | Version | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| `gsap.min.js` | `gsap` | 3.15.0 | https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gsap@3.15.0/dist/gsap.min.js |
| `ScrollTrigger.min.js` | `gsap` | 3.15.0 | https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gsap@3.15.0/dist/ScrollTrigger.min.js |
| `SplitText.min.js` | `gsap` | 3.15.0 | https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gsap@3.15.0/dist/SplitText.min.js |
| `lenis.min.js` | `lenis` | 1.3.27 | https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/lenis@1.3.27/dist/lenis.min.js |
